name: Hetzner Data Center Park Falkenstein
notes: Hetzner's official data center page lists a Data Center Park in Falkenstein, Germany, alongside its Nuremberg and Helsinki parks; third-party data center directories place Falkenstein/Vogtland in Saxony and list multiple facilities/provider presence. Capacity not disclosed in the checked public sources.

name: Wimex data center at Flugplatz Koethen
notes: Local broadcaster radio SAW reported that Wimex plans a data center on about 50 hectares at Koethen airfield, intended to use surplus renewable power; the project was described as very early stage before a development plan.

name: Bitterfeld Blue Future Technologiegebiet hyperscale data center, Marke/Raguhn-Jessnitz
developer: FAB Gesellschaft fuer Gebietsentwicklung und Infrastrukturdienstleistungen
notes: Golem, citing Mitteldeutsche Zeitung and local council activity, reported a hyperscale data center planned by 2030 near Marke, part of Raguhn-Jessnitz, on roughly 60 hectares with about 150 jobs; local councils were reconsidering or opposing the plan. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Kommunales Rechenzentrum Gov Tech Park
developer: Anhalt-Bitterfeld structural-change project proponents / local public-sector sponsors
notes: The City of Bitterfeld-Wolfen page reports that a steering group recommended Anhalt-Bitterfeld structural-change projects to the state and lists 'Kommunales Rechenzentrum Gov Tech Park' as a backup project. Public details are limited; treated as planned/early public-sector data center activity.

name: Terra Project Holding data center, Gewerbegebiet Tagewerbener Strasse/B176, Weissenfels
notes: Official Weissenfels council report says the city council approved the preliminary development plan for the 9.2-hectare Tagewerbener Strasse/B176 commercial area, enabling Terra Project Holding GmbH to build a data center with at least a three-digit-million-euro investment and up to 80 jobs. Capacity not disclosed.

name: SBB Bytefortress data center and battery storage campus, Wolmirstedt
notes: DataCenter-Insider and Golem reported that newly registered SBB Bytefortress announced a large data center with battery storage in Wolmirstedt, Landkreis Börde, near Magdeburg. Sources emphasize very limited public details and uncertainty around investors/operators; capacity not disclosed.

name: DataHall Halle (Saale) data center campus
notes: DataHall's official site lists its address at Am Saalehafen 1, 06118 Halle (Saale), and describes a renewable-energy/data-center ecosystem. DataCenter-Insider reported DataHall is planning an energy-optimized data center campus in Halle, starting from 2026 if plans proceed; Baxtel/DCD also track the project, but public IT capacity is not disclosed.
